# Contributing to MLP OS Archive

MLP OS Archive is an independent, non-commercial fan archive for MLP-related operating systems, Linux distributions, and desktop themes or customizations. Historical, discontinued, unfinished, and experimental third-party projects may qualify.

**Read the [Project Inclusion Policy](../docs/INCLUSION_POLICY.md) before contributing.** It is the authoritative source for scope, MLP relevance, development requirements, evidence, duplicates, copyright, and review states.

- To suggest a project, open the [issue form chooser](https://github.com/Evan-Windproof/MLP-OS-Archive/issues/new/choose) and choose your language. A project name, category, short description, and at least one public source URL are required to begin review.
- To add or improve a project record directly, follow the [project submission guide](../docs/PROJECT_SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md) and open a pull request against `main`.

A qualifying project must contain substantive MLP elements in its actual OS or desktop experience; a name, author nickname, community affiliation, or wallpaper-only Linux respin is not enough. Desktop theme collections can qualify independently. A submitter's own OS proposal must have actual development work, while third-party historical projects may qualify even if unfinished or no longer downloadable.

Use the original language for source material and project titles. Translations are welcome. Share only material that can be discussed publicly and credit original creators. Do not upload or mirror third-party media or software unless reuse is permitted by its license or explicit permission.

An issue is a proposal, not acceptance. Maintainers review scope, identity, duplicates, evidence, attribution, and rights. First-party evidence can establish project identity and documented history. Missing optional details do not automatically prevent inclusion; unsupported claims must remain unknown or qualified.

For releases, dated events, screenshots, downloads, and checksums, see the [historical archive guide](../docs/HISTORICAL_ARCHIVE_GUIDE.md). Add unresolved leads to the [research backlog](../docs/RESEARCH_BACKLOG.md) with source links.

## Ongoing maintenance

Use an issue for a new project, correction, or additional historical evidence. For an existing project, include its catalog URL, the specific claim or field to change, and the relevant source.

- Check each submission for scope, MLP relevance, duplicates, and provenance.
- Keep development status separate from verification, record completeness, provenance, and testing.
- If a download breaks, document when it was checked. Distinguish unavailable from unconfirmed and preserve historical references.
- For screenshots and other media, record source, attribution, and known permissions. Link while reuse rights are unclear.
- For credit corrections or removal requests, identify the affected record or asset and explain the issue. Review the source and rights; correct attribution or remove disputed assets when warranted.

Run `npm run check` and `npm run build` before merge, then inspect updated pages after deployment.
